Memoize already supports SkipMemoization exception and .memory property. But requirement R3 also needs .invalidate and .invalidate_all methods for memoize? Not specified; only cache has these. But requirement says "Both memoize and cache decorators must support raising skip exceptions to bypass caching logic. They must also provide .memory properties to inspect cached values, and .invalidate and .invalidate_all methods to clear cache entries." So memoize also needs invalidate and invalidate_all. Let's implement.

Also need to expose has_path, get_in, update_in, zip_dicts. Let's inspect colls for get_in etc.
